dedupe_keys.name: agpc an annual 500 m gridded population 1990 2020 for china incorporating 3d building volume dynamics

description: The AGPC dataset research team publishes annual 500 m population estimates for China from 1990 to 2020. The mapping method combines building volume, building function and socioeconomic predictors with census calibration and official population constraints. Version 5 distinguishes annual city-constrained layers from county-constrained benchmark layers for 2010 and 2020. Figshare lists the annual TIFF files and describes the folder organisation. The rasters are openly available and free under CC-BY-4.0, with the associated model code published separately under MIT. Grid values are disaggregated estimates, not enumerated household counts. A limitation is that administrative constraints and model assumptions influence small-area patterns, and changing constraints between releases can affect comparisons. The series could provide exposure or demand weights for transport, energy and emergency-response simulations. They complement building-footprint datasets by supplying estimated population, while users must reconcile boundaries, grid alignment and whether city-constrained or county-constrained values match the intended analysis.
